text:
I who have had the bad luck

that God fell in love with me.

I have been left out of the erotic game.

Others in those games will laugh at me.

When my love in Granada

was unlimited, were you jealous?

My sexual desires have been and are

only analogies of my love for you.

I think my sexual desires please you.

translation.title: I Who Have Had the Bad Luck
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's frank erotic theology and its address to God as beloved.
